text:
maya: hey folks — walked in and found a rubber duck on my keyboard. is this a new inside joke or did i miss a meeting? :duck:
liam: that's me. started putting them in conference rooms when meetings run over. stress ducks. :duck: :coffee:
sanjay: wait are we doing an office-wide duck economy now
kelly: i've been collecting them since last week. currently 7 ducks strong. starting a leaderboard?
maya: OP here. we need rules. who gets the 'quackbadge' for best duck placement?
ashley: suggestion: ducks get assigned to oncall to ward off paging demons. mandatory for nights.
liam: @maya put one on @sanjay's monitor earlier. he screamed. hilarious. :joy:
maya: i did not scream. i flailed. but i accept the honor. proposing rotation system — each week a duck moves to a new desk. keeps morale high.
kelly: poll pls
ops-bot: POLL: Rubber Duck Rotation? 1) Weekly 2) Random Surprise 3) Only on call 4) No ducks (ban) — react with 1️⃣/2️⃣/3️⃣/4️⃣
liam: voted 2️⃣. surprise tactic is superior.
sanjay: 3️⃣ — we need protection during midnight deploys.
ashley: 1️⃣ for me. discipline > chaos.
maya: 2️⃣ from me. chaos is a feature.
kelly: 2️⃣
ops-bot: current tally: 1️⃣ 1 vote, 2️⃣ 3 votes, 3️⃣ 1 vote, 4️⃣ 0 votes
maya: looks like surprise wins. new rule: ducks are stealth-deployed between 9–11am, no peeking.
liam: can we make custom stickers? 'redwood quack squad'?
kelly: ordering 12 mini ducks tomorrow. @finance pls approve $12
maya: budget-friendly culture initiative. @finance probably will cry but okay.
janet-bot: FYI office nickname update: 'Duckery' added to #random glossary.
ashley: if anyone gets a golden duck they become honorary 'Duck Whisperer' for that week. perks include first choice of snacks.
liam: i'm training my duck placement algorithm. input: desk density, snack proximity, caffeine levels.
sanjay: note: do not place ducks in server racks. we learned this on tuesday. :sweat_smile:
maya: archive: saved photo to #random/duck-log. great start to the morning. :duck::sparkles:
